# GitHub Copilot instructions

Start with [MOC.md](../MOC.md), [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [KNOWLEDGE.md](../KNOWLEDGE.md), and [wiki/compiled/briefing.md](../wiki/compiled/briefing.md).

Use evidence from committed `records/`, matching `source_commit_sha` and actual completed CI runs. For model changes update `wiki/models/registry.md`, `wiki/log.md`, EXP/ADR/INC and any impacted MOC; then run `python scripts/wiki_lint.py` and `pytest`. Never relabel research candidates as authorized buys. Do not mistake a successful CI smoke test for positive portfolio alpha.
